verdict.rationale: Neon exposes a comprehensive, well-documented Management API and OpenAPI spec covering project/branch lifecycle, compute, auth, data API, functions, object storage, and more, plus a 113-tool MCP surface and CLI that mirror console capabilities, and an LLM-addressed endpoint index for machine consumption. This gives strong evidence that nearly all console actions (branching, restore, autoscaling, keys, functions, storage, auth, AI gateway) are API/CLI/MCP-reachable. missing for 10: explicit vendor statement guaranteeing 1:1 API/UI parity, and independent third-party confirmation that no console-only features exist
